run_gate_up_lora_b_fwd: run the forward pass of fused gate and up LoRA B projection using a Triton kernel
run_gate_up_lora_b_kernel: run the Triton JIT kernel that packs two sgemms (gate and up) into a single launch
compute_gate_projection: compute the gate branch of the LoRA B matrix multiplication on sorted token positions
compute_up_projection: compute the up branch of the LoRA B matrix multiplication on sorted token positions
accumulate_lora_output: accumulate scaled LoRA B results into an output tensor with base output support
